title: A large explained-gain ratio can still remove little uncertainty
statement: For unbiased quadratic targets and HARD finite horizon k, the actual adaptive-worker mixture audit accepts V_ad(k)<=4 V_fixed^*[log(n+1)+.5log(k+1)]. It retains Gaussian-mixture initialization, pre-query stopping with complete random seed, selected-row energy accounting and the distinction between pathwise squared increments and final posterior-mean square. It does not extend to expected-only horizons,biased coordinates or higher degree. The signed ancestor tree has n=2^k-1,fixed gain binom(k,2),route gain sum_(t<k)t^2 and ratio(2k-1)/3. At k16,65535variables,917506 explicit terms/total variance,fixed120,route1240 explain only.1352% of uncertainty; these are formula evaluations,not a65535-source execution. Failed common-core/sign and generic predictive-state/formula-learning routes remain scoped source history.

requires: Known unbiased-sign quadratic target and HARD integer finite query horizon k.
Best fixed gain used only as deterministic analytical parameter, not a supplied computable optimum.
Explicit representation/source/measurement costs and absolute residual risk retained.

costs: With s listed quadratic coefficients, scores O(s+n) arithmetic/O(n) storage, linear selection or O(n log n) sorting, then L physical observations plus O(L+s_T) prediction work. Dense input costsTheta(n^2) to read.

General list L=min(n,ceil(3 kappa d^2 k/epsilon^2)),d>=2,0<epsilon<=1; unbiased quadratic improves to min of n,ceil(36k/epsilon^2),ceil((16k/epsilon)log(32e/epsilon)). At10% tolerance the latter is about1083k before cap.
